resources.string: Camera and ISP Tweaks for Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G: 4K 60FPS, 150Mbps Bitrate, 50MP RAW, 50MP Normal Photo, Leica Profiles, Dual Video, Long Exposure, Thermal Bypass.
Unlocks smooth 4K video recording at 60 frames per second.
Improves video recording quality for much clearer videos.
Enables uncompressed 50-megapixel RAW photos in Pro Mode.
Adds Leica Authentic and Leica Vibrant camera modes and Leica watermark.
Record video using the front and rear cameras at the same time.
Allows taking very long exposure photos (up to 60 seconds) in Pro Mode.
Stops the camera from closing automatically when the phone gets warm.
Makes the standard Photo mode take full 50-megapixel pictures.
